_comment: SpecsReach relay tuning (teleop_map.Tuning). Edit and restart the relay -- no Lens rebuild. Keys starting with _ are ignored.
_view_yaw_deg: the arm-base yaw you face from your usual spot: 0 = you look along arm +X, 90 = along +Y, 180 = you face the arm from its +X side
_filter_tau_s: 0.25 (default 0.06): the glasses deliver hand data in bursts (measured 2026-10-30: >100 ms of silence 70% of the time), so a longer low-pass turns the bursts into continuous motion. Lower it if the arm feels sluggish.
_enable_orientation: false for the first sessions: position only, so hand-tracking rotation noise cannot turn the tool. Set true to follow wrist rotation.
_lens_timeout_s: 1.0 (default 0.3): the glasses go silent for up to ~1 s (measured max 974 ms); 0.3 dropped every grab within a second. Matches the bridge's own watchdog_ms 1000 for the Quest. While silent the arm keeps gliding toward the last reported hand position, never past it.
